The high stress index (100.0) and the extreme pressure level also support the notion that the developer might be under significant stress, leading to less careful work. The calculated honesty score of 0.0 further confirms the deception. The performance score of 20.25, which is below average, also aligns with the reported progress being higher than the actual progress. These factors collectively justify the high suspicion score.
